title: Maya script
summary: The earliest identifiably Maya inscriptions date to the 3rd century BCE; Maya writing was used until the Spanish conquest.
why: The only Mesoamerican writing system substantially deciphered.
interchange: Four independent inventions of writing are most commonly recognised: Mesopotamia (c. 3400-3100 BCE), Egypt (c. 3250 BCE, still debated), China and Mesoamerica

notes.problem: Same over-strong interchange as era-B 33: 'at least four times', and Egypt's independence is not settled (History of writing).
